surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process involves alternating exposure of the substrate to tri-methyl-aluminum (TMA) and deionized water (H2O) precursors. The TMA precursor is introduced for 25 ms, followed by a purge with N2 gas for 8 s, then the H2O precursor is introduced for 25 ms, followed by another purge with N2 gas for 8 s. This cycle forms one atomic layer on the substrate surface.
